Use one exact money formatter across cards, charts and forecasts
Parent tracker: #224

**Priority:** P1 (correctness, security or verification priority).

## Problem and current evidence

The audit found direct currency Intl.NumberFormat use in components/cards/card-view.tsx, components/cards/card-chart.tsx, components/chat-chart.tsx and app/plan/forecast.tsx, plus duplicate formatMoney functions. Recheck the current tree before changing it.

## Scope

Use the existing canonical formatter where possible, otherwise consolidate the smallest exact formatter for integer minor units and explicit currency. Replace duplicated paths. Enforce against lossy money conversion and unsafe toFixed/float arithmetic in financial code with a precise rule that permits legitimate non-money calculations.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Large bigint amounts and negative amounts retain exact values.
- [ ] Zero-, two- and three-decimal currencies display correctly.
- [ ] Cards, chart tooltips, artifacts and forecasts agree on the same amount.
- [ ] Relevant money tests pass and light, dark and mobile UI evidence is captured.
- [ ] Lint rejects newly introduced unsafe money formatting without banning unrelated numeric work.

## Verification and constraints

Reproduce the current behaviour before changing it. Run the smallest relevant check during implementation, then npm test, npm run lint and npm run typecheck; add a build for app/config changes and real QA browser verification for changed user flows. Use only disposable moneo-qa services, synthetic records and mocked paid integrations. Verify source installation and desktop compatibility. Preserve financial history, corrections and undo. Do not add prose or comments in place of a deterministic boundary.

## Delivery

This issue records follow-up work; it does not claim the change is implemented. Recheck current main and #224 before starting, since the audit counts may have changed. Keep the PR focused and link its checks and relevant evidence here.
